model.template_folder: <project template folder to copy for each new model>

bambu.machine: <Bambu Studio printer preset, for example Bambu Lab P1S 0.4 nozzle>
bambu.filament: <filament preset, for example Bambu PLA Basic @BBL P1S 0.4 nozzle>

_about.models_root: The folder your model folders live in. It is matched against the brands' modelsRoot in ~/.nexus-local/accounts.json to find the brand; accounts.json is written by the Content Board app, never by this skill.
_about.content_folder: The footage folder of a project: inside each project folder in a brand with itemLayout 2 (renders and real photos go there), inside each model folder in a brand with itemLayout 1. The template's own copy of it is not copied into a new model folder for a brand with itemLayout 2.
